limitations: The six group outcome rates were transcribed from the primary article abstract; human scientific review is pending.
These are group-level percentages from a progressive learning-curve study; the 2022 conference abstract and 2025 conference cohort remain separate because no public animal crosswalk was located.
The three planned survival-goal ranges do not reveal an exact assigned goal for each fetus. In particular, the 80% result for the 48-168 h group is not an 80% seven-day survival rate.
The source reports group n and percentages but supplies no individual identifiers, individual outcomes, or linked longitudinal data in this intake.
The study describes transfer from uterus into artificial-placenta support and euthanasia after assigned goals; it does not report post-support neonatal transition or long-term developmental health.

Published Table 1 rows for bubbles in the circuit and vasospasm have a separate unresolved percentage-denominator mismatch; those complication rows are not represented by the abstract-level cannulation percentages here.

Cycle 286 pins the official PMC full-text XML (CC BY 4.0). The article surface has no supplementary-material element, and its Data Availability Statement reads “Not applicable.” Figure 3 identifies plotted dots as per-animal whole-experiment means but supplies no exact-value table or persistent animal IDs; this bounded article-surface check does not establish global data absence.

Cycle 287 visually reviewed Figure 3 in the publisher PDF (printed p. 6). The points are unlabeled and some overlap; no approximate point values were transcribed because the chart does not support a reliable point-to-value extraction. The visual review adds no biological observations.

Cycle 288 rechecked the Table 1 complication percentages against the group header and Methods/Results/Discussion. The 1 (14.3%) and 4 (57.1%) cells imply denominator seven mathematically, but the paper does not define that seven-fetus risk set; printed cells remain unchanged and no animal assignments are inferred.

Cycle 289 queried public DataCite, Zenodo, Figshare, and OSF metadata routes. No Eixarch 2023 dataset/supplement was identified among returned results; Figshare exact/author searches were broad capped result sets, two Figshare topical records were different studies, and Zenodo exact-DOI returned HTTP 500. This bounded screen does not establish global data absence; no candidate values changed.

Cycle 290 checked the PubMed record and exact-DOI/article-title searches plus Crossref relation/update metadata for a correction, erratum, or retraction. No linked correction was identified in those bounded metadata routes. The MDPI article-notes page returned HTTP 403 and could not be checked; the Table 1 denominator discrepancy remains unresolved, and no candidate observations changed.

Cycle 291 visually checked Table 1 in the publisher PDF (printed p. 5): bubbles is printed 1 (14.3%), vasospasm 4 (57.1%), and neither cell carries a specific footnote marker. The generic n (%) note does not define the implied denominator; the # note is attached only to the separate after-24-hour complications row. The discrepancy remains unresolved and candidate values were not changed.

Cycle 292 used Crossref’s documented reverse updates filter for DOI 10.3390/biomedicines11030702; zero update-linked records were returned. This is bounded to Crossref-deposited relations and does not prove absence of a correction. The publisher notes route remains unavailable, so the Table 1 denominator discrepancy remains unresolved; no candidate values changed.

Cycle 293 crosswalks all 60 printed Table 1 cell positions against the pinned publisher PDF. Forty-two direct table observations match group coverage declarations; three surgical-complication cells cross-check existing abstract summaries; five specific-complication values remain source-inventory-only because their row-specific assessment denominator is unresolved; one later-complication cell links to the existing Results count. Seven printed dashes and two N/A cells are retained as distinct states. No observation values changed.
